Method of Attack: Using malicious MSI files signed with specially crafted invalid Authenticode signatures to bypass Windows SmartScreen cloud-based anti-malware service and deploy ransomware payloads without triggering Mark-of-the-Web security alerts
Impacted Systems: Users primarily in Europe, China, Taiwan, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea
Attack Vector: Malicious MSI files distributed via malvertising and exploit kits (Magnitude Exploit Kit)
Files downloaded from the Internet bypassing SmartScreen due to invalid but specially crafted Authenticode signatures
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious MSI files with invalid Authenticode signatures
Over 100,000 downloads of malicious MSI files since January 2023
Payloads deployed via malvertising and Magnitude Exploit Kit
